id: title:georgemunyoro:offer editor quick fixes past the first statement

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HogQL syntax support and marker positioning accuracy in the Monaco editor, enabling users to receive replacement suggestions and correctly identify query markers.
review.reason: The chunk contains implementation and test changes for HogQL marker handling. P1.F1.H1 adds a HogQL script and marker offset calculations, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 switch marker overlap checks from marker-relative offsets to document offsets. This improves the reliability of HogQL marker positioning and replacement suggestions in the editor.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the localized, bounded nature of the changes. No broader systemic benefit or critical path dependency is demonstrated. The score does not account for unverified user benefit or adoption.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test file P1.F1.H1 with a multi-statement HogQL script and marker offset calculations, including a quick-fix assertion.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the Monaco code action provider correctly offers a replacement suggestion for a HogQL marker located in the second statement of a multi-line query.

observations.behavior: P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 replace marker range overlap checks from marker-relative offsets to document offsets.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses Monaco's document offset API to account for statement boundaries when checking if a marker's range overlaps the selection, rather than relying on marker-relative offsets which are relative to the metadata query.
